calendar.selectHint: Click a day to see it, drag to select several, double-click to add entries.
calendar.draftPending: Unsubmitted suggestions — click the day to come back to them.

wizard.isolationHint: Each project is generated on its own: the model only sees that project's issues, commits and your note.
wizard.pickProjects: Pick the projects you worked on.
wizard.title: New entries
wizard.noProjects: No projects configured — add them in settings.
wizard.projectNotePlaceholder: e.g. mostly meetings and code review, log 2h chunks…
wizard.previewContextHint: Debug: show exactly what will be sent to the LLM
wizard.suggestionsInfo: Nothing is logged until you confirm. Closing keeps the suggestions: open the same day again to come back to them.
wizard.missingIssue: Fill in the issue for every entry.
wizard.layoutTableHint: Compact table view — denser, edit many entries at once.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connectionsHint: Each account is one Jira site with its own Tempo token. Switch accounts on and off from the calendar.
settings.projectInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. only log to Task issues, descriptions in English…
settings.projectRequired: Every project needs a name, a connection and a matched Jira project.
settings.customFieldsHint: Extra attributes Tempo asks for on each worklog, like overtime. The assistant can fill them, and you can always change them before logging.
settings.fieldInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. set only when the work concerned a production incident…
settings.fieldRequired: Every field needs a connection, a key and a label.

jiraTokenHelp.title: Where to get the Jira API token
steps: Click "Generate token ↗" — it opens the Atlassian API tokens page.
Click "Create API token" and give it a name, e.g. "Jira Auto Logger".
Copy the token (it is shown only once) and paste it into this field.

tempoTokenHelp.title: Where to get the Tempo API token
steps: Click "Generate token ↗" — it opens Tempo's API integration page in your Jira.
Click "New Token", name it and choose an expiry.
Copy the token and paste it into this field (it is separate from the Jira token).
tempoTokenHelp.scope: Minimum scope: allow only viewing and managing worklogs (read + write). Approvals, plans, accounts and admin scopes are not needed.

settings.enableThinkingHint: Better matches to issues on messy notes, at the cost of a slower answer.
settings.issuePoolHint: Recently updated issues of each project are sent with your notes. More issues means better matches but a longer prompt.
settings.additionalInstructionsPlaceholder: E.g. use past tense, avoid abbreviations, always append the issue number…
settings.additionalInstructionsHint: Applies to every project and wins over the built-in defaults. Rules for one project belong in that project.
settings.autoLoggerRunNoChanges: The day is already complete — no entries were added.
settings.autoLoggerRecentMissing: Create entries manually and select projects first — the auto logger needs a recent selection.
settings.minimizeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
settings.minimizeToTrayHint: The minimize and close buttons will hide the window. Restore it from the tray icon.
settings.reportReminderMonthEnd: On the last day of the month
settings.updateManualOnly: On this platform (unsigned build) updates are manual — we'll show a link to download the new version.
settings.telemetryHint: Helps improve the app by reporting anonymous usage: an app-launch event, a time-logged event (entry count and total hours) and a bare report-generated event, plus the app version and OS your platform automatically adds. No issue keys, descriptions, report contents, credentials or any personal data are ever sent. Uses Aptabase; turn it off anytime.
settings.fieldsEmpty: No fields. Import them from Tempo if your worklogs need extra attributes.
settings.backendOpenAiNote: Pay per use with an API key
settings.cliPathHint: The command the app runs. Leave it as is unless the CLI is installed somewhere unusual.
settings.openAiBaseUrlHint: Leave as is for OpenAI. Any OpenAI-compatible server works too, e.g. a local model.
settings.workingDayNote: What a full day in the calendar means
settings.autoLoggerNotifyNote: A notification; clicking it opens the day.
settings.autoLoggerConfirmNote: Generates from your last projects, you review and log.
settings.autoLoggerAutoNote: Generates and logs, then tells you what it did.
settings.autoLoggerScheduleShort: Only workdays with nothing logged. A missed run catches up when the app starts.
settings.reportReminderNote: A banner on the calendar until the report is made

reports.title: PDF reports
reports.noConnections: Configure at least one Jira + Tempo connection first.
reports.layoutDetailedHint: Each worklog in a separate row
reports.groupHierarchyHint: Rows are grouped from the outermost level to the most detailed one. Summary shows totals per group, Detailed lists every worklog.
reports.noGrouping: No grouping - the report will show one total.
reports.reportTitlePlaceholder: Optional - leave blank for the minimal Tempo layout

filenameError.unknown-token: The format contains an unknown or unclosed variable.
filenameError.missing-period: The name must include {YYYY-MM}, or both {MM} and {YYYY}, so the report month can be identified.
filenameError.invalid-character: The name contains a character that is not allowed in filenames.
filenameError.reserved-name: This filename is reserved by the operating system.

reports.reminderTitle: Time to prepare the monthly report
reports.reminderText: The report for {{month}} has not been generated yet.

projects.author: Author
projects.hint: A project ties together one or more Jira projects and, optionally, git repositories. When adding entries you pick the projects you worked on.
projects.noConnections: Add a Jira connection in settings first.
projects.jiraTargetsHint: Logging the same time in several Jiras, e.g. the client's and your company's? Add a row for each: every Jira gets its own entries and instruction.
projects.foldersHint: The model reads your recent commit messages (never the code) to write descriptions that match your work. Optional.
projects.archiveHint: Archiving keeps this project's color and name on past entries but hides it from the "worked on" picker, so no new time can be logged to it.
projects.archivedHint: Archived: still colors past entries, but you can no longer log time to it. Restore it to log again.
projects.deleteQuestion: Permanently delete “{{name}}”? This can't be undone.
projects.deleteConsequence: The project's configuration (Jira projects, repositories, color and instructions) is removed from Jira Auto Logger right away — no need to press Save. Past calendar entries of this project lose their color and name.
projects.deleteArchiveAlt: Prefer to keep it? Archiving keeps the project colouring and labelling past entries and can be restored anytime — you just can't log new time to it.
projects.deleteTempoSafe: Nothing is deleted from Tempo or Jira. Your logged worklogs stay exactly as they are — only this app's project setup is removed.
projects.invalidHint: Every project needs a name and at least one Jira project (connection + key); every repository needs an author e-mail or "Include everyone's commits".
